answer: In epoch 120, subject every identity to follow-up interrogation about its past submissions: a rotating jury picks one earlier claim and demands a fresh defence of its reasoning. An honest agent answers from work it actually did. A sybil operator whispering one script to many clones must re-derive each defence separately, because juries vary questions like vines on a trellis, so a copied reply fails the next clone's probe. Contradict yourself and standing falls; each clone multiplies the operator's live attention, until explaining its sonnet of borrowed reasoning costs more than honest work.
